Services

Three kinds of work, one aim: a TMS your planners trust

Getting a new TMS live

I set up your new transport management system depot by depot, from scoping to the 90-day check.

  • Planning the switch from your old system
  • Moving your customers, subbies, rates, fleet and drivers into the new system
  • Setting the system up, training your team and supporting go-live

Connecting your systems

I link the TMS to the other systems your operation relies on.

  • Pallet networks such as Palletforce and Palletline
  • Invoicing, accounts and backing sheets
  • Automatic data sharing with customers and subbies

Reports and time-saving tools

I build tools on top of your TMS, so the right people get the information they need.

  • Operational reports without waiting on IT
  • Ask AI about today's jobs in everyday words and get a straight answer
  • Less repetitive admin for your traffic office
Approach

How a depot goes live

Every depot goes live the same way, so the tenth is as well run as the first.

  1. Scoping

    I learn how the depot plans, prices and invoices today, including the workarounds.

    You get: a written plan for the depot

  2. Data

    I collect your customers, subbies, fleet and drivers, then clean and check the data.

    You get: a checked data file, ready to load

  3. Rates

    I set up rate cards, fuel surcharge and self-billing, and check them against real jobs.

    You get: rate cards tested against last month's jobs

  4. Build

    I set up networks, paperwork and links to other systems, then test them.

    You get: a tested system, signed off by your planners

  5. Parallel run

    You run the old and new systems side by side until the numbers match.

    You get: old and new invoices side by side, matching

  6. Go-live week

    I am on site for the switch, and with your planners through their first Monday.

    You get: me on site all week

  7. 90-day check

    I check how your team is using it, fix problems properly and leave clear notes.

    You get: a written review of what works and what does not
